## Activity

During October 2024, Hill Counties Health Centre recorded 110 captures. This report summarises the site’s activity for the month and provides the associated image-quality and grading outcomes. The capture total is the basis for reviewing the number of images that could be assessed and the number that required referral.

## Image quality

A total of 12 captures were marked ungradable. The ungradable rate was 10.9% of captures. This measure indicates the proportion of images that could not be used for grading and is reported alongside the monthly capture activity. The ungradable findings should be considered when reviewing the site’s overall imaging performance for October 2024.

## Grading

Grading identified 14 referable results. The median grading lag was 1 day. The referable total and grading lag provide the reported summary of grading activity for Hill Counties Health Centre during the month. Staff raised no new equipment faults this month.
